FX-SELECT-001.says: The line chosen, keep chosen: only the box's line and its half-covering edge are left, the edge still half covering; the skin and the trace line become transparent.

FX-SELECT-002.says: The line chosen, keep others: the line and its edge become transparent, and the skin and the trace line are left.

FX-SELECT-003.says: No colour chosen, keep chosen: the drawing, untouched.

FX-SELECT-004.says: No colour chosen, keep others: the drawing, untouched.

FX-SELECT-005.says: The line and the trace line chosen, keep chosen: both lines are left, and only the skin goes.

FX-SELECT-006.says: FX-SELECT-001 with the colour written in capitals: the same.

FX-SELECT-007.says: #28242e chosen, 10 above the line on every channel, keep chosen, tolerance keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 20 at frame 4, linear: frames 0 and 1 choose nothing and so keep nothing, and the frame is empty; frame 2, at exactly 10, is FX-SELECT-001, and so is frame 4.

FX-SELECT-008.says: FX-SELECT-001 moved three pixels right: the same, moved.

FX-SELECT-009.says: Tolerance 255, keep others: every pixel that shows is chosen, so the frame is empty.

FX-SELECT-010.says: Tolerance 256, above 255. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-SELECT-011.says: Tolerance -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-SELECT-012.says: Tolerance keyed to 300 at frame 4. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-SELECT-013.says: Nine colours, one more than eight. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-SELECT-014.says: A colour written "#12345", one digit short. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-SELECT-015.says: Keep "both", which is not a choice. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-SELECT-016.says: Keep "Chosen", in a capital, which is kept as written and is not the word. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
